subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror and inter-session transcript rows before merge?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it intentionally changes A2A message-delivery eligibility in a path where green CI cannot prove every real channel history.

options.title: Accept Boundary
options.body: Land after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the added Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

options.title: Request Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel transcript if maintainer confidence requires production-channel evidence beyond the deterministic QA harness.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Work
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the reverse-send and compaction-related A2A duplicate fixes resolved under one coordinated delivery plan.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head checks because the fix is narrow and the added Gateway/QA proof targets the duplicate visible-message failure mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent delivery-mirror transcript provenance work makes vincentkoc the best available owner for this message-delivery boundary decision.
